description: This file contains utility functions that generate MongoDB aggregation query objects for fetching store products with filters, including price and rating, and for retrieving wishlist status for products based on user ID.

methods.name: getStoreProductsQuery
methods.description: Generates a MongoDB aggregation pipeline to fetch store products filtered by price range and rating, including brand and review data.

methods.name: getStoreProductsWishListQuery
methods.description: Generates a MongoDB aggregation pipeline to determine if products are liked by a specific user based on wishlist data.
